<div class="card-body">
'''Crash Landing''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">不時着</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットの搭乗したＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいる時に使用する。同じ位置か隣接する屋外位置にいる乗用生物以外のビークルを目標とする。運命数を引く。ＡＴ－ＡＴがビークル用兵器を有しているなら、運命数に１を加える。運命数の合計＞３なら目標は“クラッシュ”する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Crash-Landing-PSA-149261357.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴの武装は動作が緩慢で、高速で飛ぶスノースピーダーが直撃弾を受ける可能性は低い。だが光弾の威力は強烈で、かすれば不時着は免れない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Forced landing.

'''Card text:'''
Use when a piloted AT-AT is at a site. Target a non-creature vehicle at the same or an adjacent exterior site. Draw destiny. If the AT-AT has a vehicle weapon, add 1 to destiny. The target 'crashes' if total destiny > 3.

'''Lore:'''
AT-AT weapons are slow, so a fast snowspeeder is unlikely to take a direct hit. The bolts are still powerful, and a graze forces a crash landing.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Crash Landing]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
